Bihar ke rohtas jile men bekhauph apradhiyon ne dinadhare ek bar phir pulis ki gasht aur suraksha davon ki dhajjiyan ura di hain. jile ke kochas thana kshetr men mahatma gandhi chauk ke samip sasaram-chausa mukhy marg par sthit kanchan jvelars ko nishana banate hue apache savar char nakabposh hathiyarband apradhiyon ne 3 karor rupye ke sone-chandi ke aabhushnon ki bhishan dakaiti ko anjam diya hai.
